environment.description: ECS Fargate task running payment-consumer service. SQS queue (payment-events-prod) has SendMessage permission granted to the merchant webhook Lambda. The DB user 'payment_svc' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the payments schema. CloudWatch logs are accessible to the same IAM role. DLQ is configured with maxReceiveCount=5. The consumer processes messages and the error handler exposes padding oracle distinguisher via CloudWatch Logs Insights queries accessible to any authenticated principal with logs:FilterLogEvents on the log group.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON payments.* TO 'payment_svc'@'%'
